zh-CN.title: 广场回复关系更准确
items: 回复二级评论时会准确展示实际回复对象，不再因昵称相同而遗漏
QQ 迁移评论会按对话发生顺序还原回复关系，正文不再重复显示用于回复的艾特

en.title: Clearer reply relationships in Square
items: Replies to nested comments now show the actual target even when that person also wrote the root comment
Migrated QZone conversations now restore reply targets in chronological order without repeating reply mentions
